text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, borderline thrombocytopenia, and elevated red cell distribution width and basophils. These findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or an underlying hematologic disorder. Immediate clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended. Other parameters are within normal limits.
